g.text: Automation budget per year (70% time gain)

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Assumptions: €650/day (€81.25/h), 8 h day. Unstable team: +25 % time per request and 2 × 15 onboarding days a year (€19,500).

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #898781

g.text: Budget = 70% of the time per request (optimistic view); it must cover licence, integration, maintainer time and training.
